stock.description: Operating within the People's Republic of China, PW Medtech Group Limited is an investment holding company primarily engaged in the medical device industry. The company specializes in the manufacturing and distribution of a diverse portfolio of medical consumables, including various types of infusion sets such as non-PVC, precision filter, and light-resistant models, alongside intravenous cannula products and insulin needles and pens. Beyond its core medical device activities, the group also provides property management services. Established in 1997, the company, previously known as Pyholding Limited, maintains its corporate headquarters in Beijing, China.
